offering_description.value: Crawford & Company provides outsourced claims adjusting, claims administration, and managed property repair for insurers, self-insured employers, and public entities. It delivers these services through claims professionals, digital claims platforms, and a network of repair contractors.

primary_services.value: Property and casualty loss adjusting; third-party claims administration; managed property repair; catastrophe claims response; medical case management

customer_segment.value: B2B: Insurers, reinsurers, and self-insured employers; B2G: Government entities and public-sector risk pools

end_markets.value: Property and casualty insurance; workers’ compensation; corporate risk management; public-sector risk management

revenue_model.value: service fees: Claim investigation and adjustment, case management, and repair coordination; project or contract: Outsourced claims administration programs and catastrophe response assignments

value_chain_position.value: service provider: Handles referred claims for insurers and self-insured organizations and coordinates repairs through independent contractors

geography_served.value: global: North America, Latin America, Europe, Africa, and Asia-Pacific

specialization.value: related lines: Loss adjusting, claims administration, managed repair, and medical case management

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Insurer, employer, and public-sector accounts; partners / resellers: Vetted contractor network that delivers property repairs

regulatory_exposure.value: high: Claims adjuster and third-party administrator licensing by state insurance departments where required, plus claims handling and privacy rules
